environment.description: EKS cluster v1.28, pod deployed in 'catalog' namespace with Istio 1.20 sidecar. Mesh-wide PeerAuthentication set to STRICT mTLS. An AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied to the catalog namespace with spec.action DENY for requests where source.namespace is not in ['catalog', 'api-gateway']. Additionally, a second AuthorizationPolicy with ALLOW action requires source.principal to match 'cluster.local/ns/api-gateway/sa/gateway-sa' for the CatalogService/ExecuteQuery method. The pod's iptables rules are managed by istio-init container redirecting all inbound traffic through Envoy on port 15006. Note: the DENY policy uses a notNamespaces field which has known edge-case behavior in Istio <1.19 but is correctly evaluated in 1.20.2. The sidecar resource limits are set to 256Mi/500m which under extreme load could theoretically cause Envoy to crash, but HPA maintains 3 replicas minimum.
